title: NISHAD THAIVALAPPIL: Exclusive News Stories, Articles, Top Stories by NISHAD THAIVALAPPIL on Current Affairs, Events at News18
text: Nishad Thaivalappil is a Lifestyle and Entertainment Journalist with almost a decade-long odyssey in the realms of movies, music, culture, food, and travel. He leads the Lifestyle desk at News18.com. Besides having a key eye for Lifestyle events and trends, he has interviewed eminent personalities from Bollywood, Hollywood and other regional cinemas. With his network that pans across India and abroad, Nishad has bagged a number of All-India exclusive stories and interviews over the last decade. He holds a Post Graduate Diploma in Broadcast Journalism from Asian College of Journalism, Chennai. A true-blue Mumbaikar, Nishad can be reached at nishad.t@nw18.com.
